get.description:
Returns aggregated finance statistics for admin dashboards.

Supported finance types:
- `external` = non-contracted shipments
- `meal` = contracted meal settlement
- `monthly` = contracted monthly settlement

Data includes:
- pending shipments count and amount
- paid shipments count and amount
- paid payment records count
- unique traders count

post.summary: Create a new contracted trader (Admin only)
post.description:
Allows an **admin** to create a new contracted trader along with their contract.
- You can either provide a simple contract (without branches) using `fixedShipmentDays` and `estimatedquantityPerShipment`.
- Or provide a detailed list of branches with their own schedules under `branches[]`.
- Each branch **must include `doshTypeId`** to specify which type of Dosh this branch handles.
- Branches are created automatically; **do not include `locationId`** — the system will generate them.
- If no branches are provided, the system will automatically create a **default main branch** using `contract.estimatedquantityPerShipment` and `contract.fixedShipmentDays`.
- `settlementType` defines how settlements happen (`meal` or `monthly`).
- `paymentMethod` defines how the trader receives payment (`cash`, `wallet`, `bankTransfer`).
- If `paymentMethod=wallet`, send `contract.receivingMethods.wallet.walletNumber`.
- If `paymentMethod=bankTransfer`, send `contract.receivingMethods.bankTransfer.bankName` and `accountNumber`.

post.summary: Accept shipment at pickup (Representative)
post.description:
Allows a representative to **accept a shipment during pickup inspection**.
- Shipment must be in `approved` state.
- Updates status to `pending_admin_review`.
- Adds inspection log (action=accepted, notes, uploaded images, rank).
- ⚠️ Request must be sent as **multipart/form-data** to include image uploads.

message.example: Shipment accepted successfully and pending admin review

400.description: Invalid input (e.g. missing rank or invalid images)

post.summary: Reject shipment at pickup (Representative)
post.description:
Allows a representative to **reject a shipment during pickup inspection**.
- Shipment must be in `approved` state.
- Updates status to `rejected`.
- Adds inspection log (action=rejected, reason, uploaded images, rank).
- ⚠️ Request must be sent as **multipart/form-data** to support image uploads.

rank.description:
Optional rating of shipment quality before rejection
(1 = very poor, 5 = excellent)

400.description: Invalid input (e.g. missing reason or invalid rank)

403.description: Forbidden (not allowed in current shipment state)

post.summary: Modify shipment items then accept at pickup (Representative)
post.description:
Allows a representative to **submit a full snapshot of shipment items during pickup inspection, then accept it**.
- Shipment must be in `approved` state.
- The backend compares `updatedItems` with the trader's original `items` to detect differences (added / removed / modified).
- Updates status to `pending_admin_review`.
- Adds inspection log (action=updated_and_accepted, with before/after items, diff, notes, uploaded images, and rank).
- ⚠️ Request must be sent as **multipart/form-data** because images are uploaded.

updatedItems.description:
Full snapshot of items after inspection, as a JSON stringified array.
Example:
`[{"doshType":"66b5c8d4e4d0f9b4c9876543","quantityKg":120}]`

example.notes: Checked on-site, adjusted quantities and added missing type.

400.description: Invalid input (e.g. missing or malformed updatedItems)

post.summary: Record actual weight at scale for a shipment segment
post.description:
Allows a **representative** to record the actual measured weight of a shipment segment.
- The segment **must** be in `in_transit_to_scale`.
- After weighing, the segment status becomes `in_transit_to_destination`.
- One or more **scale proof images** must be uploaded.
- The weight and optional note are stored in the `weightReport`.

post.summary: Confirm delivery for a shipment segment
post.description:
Allows a **representative** to confirm delivery of a segment to its final destination (factory or warehouse).
- The segment **must** be in `in_transit_to_destination`.
- The representative must provide the recipient's name and one or more signature/proof images.
- Once confirmed, the segment status changes to `delivered`, and the shipment is marked fully delivered if all segments are done.

Allows a **representative** to report a failed shipment segment.

post.summary: Create a new shipment request
post.description:
Allows a verified trader (contracted or uncontracted) to create a new shipment request pending admin review.

⚠️ Business Rules:

🔹 trader_contracted:
  - `sourceLocationId` is required.
  - Manual shipment creation is treated as **outside contract**.
  - `receivingMethod` is REQUIRED.
  - Settlement for this shipment follows the external/manual flow, not the contract schedule flow.

🔹 trader_uncontracted:
  - Must use `customPickupAddress`.
  - If not provided → system falls back to trader's main branch.

🔹 settlementType = external:
  - `receivingMethod` is REQUIRED.
  - Must be one of the trader's enabled receiving methods.

🔹 trader_contracted manual shipment:
  - Even if the trader has a monthly or meal contract, this manual shipment is considered **outside contract**.
  - `receivingMethod` must be provided.

🔹 Images:
  - Max 3 files.
  - Request must be sent as multipart/form-data.

🔹 items:
  - Must be a JSON stringified array.

sourceLocationId.description:
MongoDB ObjectId of trader's source location.
Required for trader_contracted.
Must not be included for trader_uncontracted.

customPickupAddress.description:
Pickup address text for trader_uncontracted.
If omitted → fallback to main branch.

requestedPickupAt.description:
Preferred pickup time (ISO 8601).
Must be at least LEAD_HOURS (e.g., 72 hours) from now.

receivingMethod.description:
Required for:
- trader_uncontracted shipments
- trader_contracted manual shipments created outside contract
Must match one of the trader's enabled receiving methods.

items.description:
JSON stringified array of dosh items.
Each item must include:
  - doshType (ObjectId)
  - quantityKg (number)

Example:
[{"doshType":"66b5c8d4e4d0f9b4c9876543","quantityKg":500}]

contracted_trader.summary: Contracted trader manual shipment outside contract

201.description: Shipment created successfully and pending admin review

400.description: Validation failed (missing required fields, invalid receivingMethod, or receiving method not enabled for trader)

404.description: Trader profile or location not found

get.summary: Get pickup dates only for calendar view
get.description:
Returns a **lightweight list of pickup dates only** (`requestedPickupAt`)  
to be used in calendar / agenda / availability views.

🔐 **Role-based behavior**:
- **trader_uncontracted / trader_contracted** → returns dates for shipments where `traderId = logged-in user`
- **representative** → returns dates for shipments where `representativeId = logged-in user`
- **admin** → returns all pickup dates (no ownership filtering)

⚡ Performance notes:
- This endpoint returns **dates only** (no shipment details).
- No populate, no heavy payload.
- Optimized for calendar rendering.

parameters.description: Language for response messages (English or Arabic)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Start date (inclusive) for filtering pickup dates.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
End date (inclusive) for filtering pickup dates.
Format: YYYY-MM-DD

patch.description:
Allows a trader to edit their own shipment **only if it is still in `pending` status**.

- Supported updates:
  - `requestedPickupAt` (preferred pickup date)
  - `items` (must be passed as a JSON string when using multipart/form-data)
  - `uploadedImages` (replaces old images, max 3)
  - `userNotes`
  - `customPickupAddress` (**only for trader_uncontracted**)  
    - If provided, replaces the previous address.  
    - If omitted, the original value remains unchanged.

- Re-uploading `uploadedImages` will replace existing ones.
- Requires optimistic concurrency via version header (`If-Match` or `x-version`) if provided.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional version number for optimistic concurrency control

schema.description: At least one field must be provided

requestedPickupAt.description: New requested pickup date (must respect lead-time policy)

items.description:
JSON stringified array of dosh items.  
Example: `[{"doshType":"66b5c8d4e4d0f9b4c9876543","quantityKg":500}]`

uploadedImages.description: New images to upload (replaces old ones, max 3)

customPickupAddress.description:
Optional pickup address text (only for trader_uncontracted).  
Example: "شبرا مصر - بجوار محطة المترو"

400.description: Invalid input (e.g. no fields provided, invalid date, invalid doshType)

409.description: Cannot edit shipment in its current status

get.summary: Get shipment history for the logged-in user

⚠️ The `status` filter is **not allowed** here and is enforced by the system.
